senses.en: a legal process to settle a dispute in court
senses.pattern: take legal action / bring an action against sb / a court action
senses.example: The tenants brought an [[action]] against the landlord, who had refused to return their deposits for months.
senses.example_zh: 房東好幾個月都拒絕退還押金，房客們於是對他提起訴訟。
senses.note: legal action 不可數；an action 可數

senses.en: the effect one thing has on another
senses.pattern: the action of the waves / the action of acid on metal / by the action of sunlight
senses.example: Over thousands of years, the [[action]] of wind and rain carved these rocks into strange shapes.
senses.example_zh: 數千年來，風和雨的作用把這些岩石雕刻成奇特的形狀。

gsat.sentence: They lick the rails to pick up iron filings caused by the [[action]] of wheels against tracks.

senses.en: because; for the reason that
senses.pattern: as it was late / as he was ill / as we had no choice
senses.example: [[As]] the last bus had already left, we had no choice but to walk home.
senses.example_zh: 由於末班公車已經開走，我們別無選擇，只能走路回家。
senses.note: 語氣比 because 弱，多放句首

senses.en: although (used after an adjective or adverb)
senses.pattern: young as he is / hard as I tried / strange as it may seem / much as I like it
senses.example: Young [[as]] she is, the pianist has already performed in concert halls around the world.
senses.example_zh: 這位鋼琴家雖然年輕，卻已在世界各地的音樂廳演出過。
senses.note: 倒裝：形容詞／副詞＋as＋主詞＋動詞

senses.en: while something else is gradually changing
senses.pattern: as time goes by / as we grow older / as technology advances
senses.example: [[As]] the population ages, the demand for nursing care is expected to rise sharply.
senses.example_zh: 隨著人口老化，照護的需求預計將急遽上升。

gsat.sentence: [[As]] the children grow, they run around the village in a pack, wearing identical clothing and hairstyles, staring at everyone impolitely.

senses.en: to have or show a name, mark, or feature
senses.pattern: bear a name / bear a mark / bear a signature / bear a resemblance to
senses.example: The old letter [[bore]] the signature of a famous poet, which made it extremely valuable.
senses.example_zh: 那封舊信帶有一位著名詩人的簽名，因此極為珍貴。

senses.en: to take responsibility for; to endure
senses.pattern: bear the cost / bear responsibility / can't bear the pain
senses.example: Whoever breaks the lab equipment must [[bear]] the full cost of replacing it.
senses.example_zh: 無論誰弄壞實驗室的設備，都必須承擔全部的更換費用。

senses.en: to produce fruit or flowers; to give birth to
senses.pattern: bear fruit / bear seeds / bear a child
senses.example: The mango tree in our yard did not [[bear]] fruit until its sixth year.
senses.example_zh: 我們院子裡的芒果樹直到第六年才結果。
senses.note: 三態 bear–bore–borne；bear fruit 亦指「有成果」

gsat.sentence: The 10 bells vary in size, each [[bearing]] a name.
It allows redwood trees to [[bear]] seeds.

senses.en: to believe or accept something, especially something unlikely
senses.pattern: buy an excuse / buy sb's story / buy an explanation / I don't buy it
senses.example: The company says the price increase is necessary, but few customers are [[buying]] that explanation.
senses.example_zh: 公司說漲價是不得已的，但很少顧客相信這個說法。
senses.note: 口語用法，多用於否定句

senses.en: to gain extra time by delaying something
senses.pattern: buy time / buy sb some time / buy a few more days
senses.example: The goalkeeper pretended to be injured to [[buy]] time for his exhausted teammates.
senses.example_zh: 守門員假裝受傷，替筋疲力盡的隊友爭取時間。

senses.en: something that causes worry or anxiety
senses.pattern: without a care in the world / the cares of daily life / free from care
senses.example: Lying on the beach, he felt as if all his [[cares]] had been washed away by the waves.
senses.example_zh: 躺在沙灘上，他覺得所有的煩惱彷彿都被海浪沖走了。

senses.en: to like or want something (formal)
senses.pattern: Would you care for…? / care to join us / care to comment
senses.example: Would you [[care]] for another cup of tea while you wait for the manager?
senses.example_zh: 等經理的時候，您想要再來一杯茶嗎？
senses.note: 用於客氣的詢問或否定句

senses.en: a hidden problem or disadvantage
senses.pattern: there's a catch / What's the catch? / the only catch is that
senses.example: The job pays well and offers long holidays, so I kept wondering what the [[catch]] was.
senses.example_zh: 這份工作薪水高、假期又長，所以我一直在想其中有什麼隱藏的問題。

senses.en: to manage to hear or understand what is said
senses.pattern: catch sb's name / didn't catch what sb said / catch the meaning
senses.example: The station was so noisy that I failed to [[catch]] the announcement about my train.
senses.example_zh: 車站太吵了，我沒聽清楚關於我那班火車的廣播。

senses.en: the amount of fish caught
senses.pattern: the day's catch / a good catch / the fish catch
senses.example: The fishermen returned to port at dawn and sold their entire [[catch]] within an hour.
senses.example_zh: 漁夫在黎明時回港，一小時內就把全部漁獲賣光了。

gsat.sentence: Jane: I'm sorry, I didn't [[catch]] your last name.
Iceland has increased their fish [[catch]] by 30% in the last 20 years.

senses.en: happening by accident, not planned
senses.pattern: a chance meeting / a chance encounter / a chance discovery / a chance remark
senses.example: A [[chance]] meeting on a train led the two scientists to work together for twenty years.
senses.example_zh: 火車上的一次偶然相遇，讓這兩位科學家合作了二十年。

senses.en: to do or find something by accident
senses.pattern: chance upon sth / chance on an old friend / chance to do sth
senses.example: While cleaning the attic, I [[chanced]] upon a box of letters my grandfather wrote during the war.
senses.example_zh: 打掃閣樓時，我偶然發現一箱祖父在戰時寫的信。

senses.en: to stop doing, studying, or discussing something
senses.pattern: drop a plan / drop a course / drop the subject / drop the charges
senses.example: The committee decided to [[drop]] the proposal after most parents strongly objected to it.
senses.example_zh: 在多數家長強烈反對後，委員會決定放棄這項提案。

senses.en: to leave someone out of a team or group
senses.pattern: drop sb from the team / be dropped from the list / be dropped for the final
senses.example: After missing three practices in a row, the striker was [[dropped]] from the school team.
senses.example_zh: 連續缺席三次練習後，那名前鋒被校隊除名。

gsat.sentence: Deemed a public hazard, the project was immediately [[dropped]], and traffic lights were banned until their return in 1929 back to the British streets.

senses.en: dull and boring, lacking interesting details
senses.pattern: a dry lecture / a dry subject / dry facts and figures
senses.example: The textbook was so [[dry]] that most students fell asleep after reading only two pages.
senses.example_zh: 這本教科書非常枯燥乏味，大多數學生才讀兩頁就睡著了。

senses.en: (of humor) funny while seeming serious
senses.pattern: dry humor / a dry wit / a dry sense of humor
senses.example: Our math teacher has a [[dry]] sense of humor and tells jokes without ever smiling.
senses.example_zh: 我們數學老師有種冷面的幽默感，講笑話時自己從來不笑。

senses.en: to arrange something cleverly, often in secret
senses.pattern: engineer a comeback / engineer a meeting / engineer sb's downfall
senses.example: Lily's friends secretly [[engineered]] a meeting between her and the classmate she had quarreled with.
senses.example_zh: 莉莉的朋友暗中策劃了一場會面，讓她和吵過架的同學碰面。

senses.en: to design or change something using scientific methods
senses.pattern: genetically engineered crops / be engineered to do / precisely engineered
senses.example: Scientists have [[engineered]] a new type of rice that can survive long periods of flooding.
senses.example_zh: 科學家已改造出一種能耐受長期淹水的新品種稻米。

gsat.sentence: It looks like a precisely [[engineered]] jigsaw puzzle, each branch growing just perfectly so it almost, but not quite, touches the neighboring tree.

senses.en: food given to farm animals
senses.pattern: animal feed / cattle feed / feed for livestock
senses.example: Rising corn prices have made animal [[feed]] much more expensive for local pig farmers.
senses.example_zh: 玉米價格上漲，使當地養豬戶的動物飼料成本大幅增加。

senses.en: to put something into a machine or system
senses.pattern: feed data into a computer / feed paper into the printer / feed coins into a machine
senses.example: The researchers [[fed]] ten years of weather data into the computer to predict future floods.
senses.example_zh: 研究人員把十年的氣象資料輸入電腦，以預測未來的水患。

senses.en: to make a feeling or problem grow stronger
senses.pattern: feed fears / feed rumors / feed sb's anger / feed an addiction
senses.example: False reports on social media only [[fed]] people's fears about the safety of the new vaccine.
senses.example_zh: 社群媒體上的不實報導只是助長了民眾對新疫苗安全性的恐懼。

gsat.sentence: It may replace [[feed]] for livestock.
Dioxin travels by air currents and settles onto grass, which is then eaten by cows and chickens in their [[feed]].

senses.en: without something unwanted or harmful
senses.pattern: free of chemicals / free from pain / free from worry / sugar-free
senses.example: Farmers here grow vegetables that are completely [[free]] of chemical fertilizers and pesticides.
senses.example_zh: 這裡的農夫種植完全不含化學肥料和農藥的蔬菜。

senses.en: to release someone, or remove something unpleasant from them
senses.pattern: free a prisoner / free someone from / free up time
senses.example: The robot vacuum [[frees]] busy parents from the daily chore of sweeping the floor.
senses.example_zh: 掃地機器人使忙碌的父母擺脫每天掃地的家務。

gsat.sentence: It must be [[free]] from impurity, while exhibiting some fruitiness and creating a pleasant bitter flavor along with a peppery sensation in the mouth.
We naively believe that somehow we are [[free]] from the problems our parents had.

senses.en: the good results of work or effort
senses.pattern: bear fruit / the fruits of one's labor / the fruit of years of research
senses.example: After years of practice, her efforts finally bore [[fruit]] when she won the national contest.
senses.example_zh: 經過多年練習，她的努力終於有了成果，贏得了全國比賽。
senses.note: bear fruit 指「有成果、奏效」

senses.en: a natural ability or talent
senses.pattern: a gift for languages / have a gift for / a natural gift
senses.example: Even as a child, Lily had a rare [[gift]] for making strangers feel comfortable around her.
senses.example_zh: 莉莉從小就有一種難得的天賦，能讓陌生人在她身邊感到自在。

senses.en: to have enough space for a number or amount
senses.pattern: hold 500 people / hold two liters of water / hold a large audience
senses.example: The new school auditorium can [[hold]] up to eight hundred students and teachers.
senses.example_zh: 新的學校禮堂最多可容納八百名師生。

senses.en: to have a particular belief or opinion
senses.pattern: hold that / hold the view that / hold strong opinions / be held responsible
senses.example: Many experts [[hold]] that reading for pleasure is the best way to build vocabulary.
senses.example_zh: 許多專家認為，為樂趣而閱讀是累積字彙的最好方法。
senses.note: 常接 that 子句；三態 hold–held–held

senses.en: to remain true or valid; to stay unchanged
senses.pattern: hold true / hold good / the rule still holds / if the weather holds
senses.example: The old saying that practice makes perfect still [[holds]] true for language learners today.
senses.example_zh: 「熟能生巧」這句老話，對今日的語言學習者依然適用。

gsat.sentence: But does this [[hold]] true across time and cultures?
From Turkey, she boarded a small boat that [[held]] 20 people and set sail into the deep waters of the Aegean Sea.

senses.en: to do what one has promised or agreed to
senses.pattern: honor a promise / honor an agreement / honor a contract / honor a commitment
senses.example: Whatever happens next season, the club must [[honor]] the three-year contract it signed with the coach.
senses.example_zh: 無論下個球季情況如何，球隊都必須履行與教練簽下的三年合約。

senses.en: a high level of achievement in school or university studies
senses.pattern: graduate with honors / with highest honors / an honors student
senses.example: She graduated from medical school with [[honors]] and was soon offered a position at a teaching hospital.
senses.example_zh: 她以優異成績從醫學院畢業，不久就獲得一家教學醫院的職位。

gsat.sentence: Although Jeffery had to keep two part-time jobs to support his family, he never neglected his studies. In fact, he graduated with [[honors]].

senses.en: to increase suddenly by a large amount
senses.pattern: jump by 20% / jump from A to B / prices jump / sales jump
senses.example: Vegetable prices [[jumped]] by forty percent after the typhoon destroyed crops across the south.
senses.example_zh: 颱風摧毀南部各地的農作物後，菜價暴漲了四成。
senses.note: 亦作名詞：a jump in prices 價格驟升

senses.en: to move suddenly because of surprise or fear
senses.pattern: make sb jump / jump at the noise / jump out of one's skin
senses.example: A loud knock on the window made everyone in the quiet library [[jump]].
senses.example_zh: 窗戶上一聲響亮的敲擊，讓安靜的圖書館裡每個人都嚇一跳。

senses.en: to own and take care of animals
senses.pattern: keep chickens / keep bees / keep a pet / keep goats
senses.example: My uncle [[keeps]] bees on his farm and sells the honey at the weekend market.
senses.example_zh: 我叔叔在農場飼養蜜蜂，並在週末市集販售蜂蜜。

senses.en: (of food) to stay fresh and good to eat
senses.pattern: keep well / keep for a week / won't keep long
senses.example: Cooked rice does not [[keep]] well in hot weather, so eat it within a day.
senses.example_zh: 煮熟的米飯在大熱天裡不易保鮮，所以要在一天內吃完。

gsat.sentence: Is it a good idea to [[keep]] animals in sites not suited to them?

senses.en: to succeed in getting a job, contract, or role
senses.pattern: land a job / land a contract / land a role / land a deal
senses.example: After dozens of interviews, she finally [[landed]] a job at a well-known design studio.
senses.example_zh: 經過數十次面試，她終於得到一家知名設計工作室的工作。

senses.en: to put someone in a difficult or unpleasant situation
senses.pattern: land sb in trouble / land sb in jail / land sb in the hospital
senses.example: Skipping classes again and again finally [[landed]] him in serious trouble at school.
senses.example_zh: 一再翹課終於使他在學校陷入大麻煩。

senses.en: a country or region (literary)
senses.pattern: a foreign land / a distant land / their native land / a land of opportunity
senses.example: The old sailor loved to tell stories about his adventures in distant [[lands]].
senses.example_zh: 那位老水手喜歡講述他在遙遠國度的冒險故事。

gsat.sentence: The islands soon attracted traders from different [[lands]].
King Henry V of England is credited with having invented the first true passport, as a way of helping his subjects prove who they were in foreign [[lands]].

senses.en: remaining after tax or costs are taken away
senses.pattern: net profit / net income / net weight / net loss
senses.example: The label says the [[net]] weight of the cookies is 200 grams, not including the tin box.
senses.example_zh: 標籤上寫著這盒餅乾的淨重是兩百公克，不含鐵盒。
senses.note: 反義詞為 gross（總的、毛的）

senses.en: to earn an amount of money as profit
senses.pattern: net a profit / net sb sth / net millions
senses.example: The charity concert [[netted]] over two million dollars for the children's hospital.
senses.example_zh: 這場慈善音樂會為兒童醫院淨賺了兩百多萬元。

senses.en: information or a warning given before something happens
senses.pattern: advance notice / at short notice / until further notice / without notice
senses.example: The museum will remain closed until further [[notice]] while workers repair the damaged roof.
senses.example_zh: 工人修復受損屋頂期間，博物館將持續休館，何時重新開放另行通知。

senses.en: a written or printed announcement put in a public place
senses.pattern: put up a notice / a notice on the board / a public notice
senses.example: A [[notice]] on the classroom door said that the math test had been moved to Friday.
senses.example_zh: 教室門上的公告寫著，數學考試已改到星期五。

senses.en: a planned activity involving many people, such as soldiers or rescuers
senses.pattern: a rescue operation / a military operation / a police operation / launch an operation
senses.example: More than two hundred volunteers joined the rescue [[operation]] after the earthquake struck the village.
senses.example_zh: 地震襲擊村莊後，兩百多名志工加入了救援行動。

senses.en: the working or running of a business or system
senses.pattern: begin operation / be in operation / come into operation / business operations
senses.example: The new subway line will begin [[operation]] next spring, cutting travel time to the airport by half.
senses.example_zh: 新的地鐵路線將於明年春天開始營運，讓前往機場的時間減半。

gsat.sentence: If student enrollment continues to drop, some programs at the university may be eliminated to reduce the [[operation]] costs.
But trading online is gaining popularity these days, with several sites in [[operation]], including HomeExchanges.

senses.en: one of the large pieces forming the earth's surface
senses.pattern: tectonic plates / the Pacific Plate / plate movement / where two plates meet
senses.example: Earthquakes often happen where two [[plates]] push against each other deep under the ground.
senses.example_zh: 地震常發生在兩個板塊於地底深處互相推擠的地方。

senses.en: a flat piece of metal with numbers or a name
senses.pattern: a license plate / a number plate / a brass plate / a name plate
senses.example: A witness wrote down the license [[plate]] of the car that drove away after the accident.
senses.example_zh: 一名目擊者記下了事故後駛離的那輛車的車牌。

gsat.sentence: The Indian [[plate]]’s northward movement is not new.
Such dangers are now obvious in India, where the movement of the [[plate]] continues.

senses.en: to improve something by making small changes
senses.pattern: polish an essay / polish a speech / polish one's skills / polish up one's English
senses.example: He stayed up late to [[polish]] his speech, cutting weak sentences and adding a stronger ending.
senses.example_zh: 他熬夜潤飾演講稿，刪去無力的句子，並加上更有力的結尾。

senses.en: a high level of skill or style
senses.pattern: lack polish / add polish to a performance / need a little more polish
senses.example: The young band played with plenty of energy, but their performance still lacked [[polish]].
senses.example_zh: 這個年輕樂團演奏得活力十足，但他們的表演仍不夠精湛、純熟。

senses.en: to combine money or resources for shared use
senses.pattern: pool resources / pool money / pool ideas / pool one's savings
senses.example: The three roommates [[pooled]] their savings to buy a secondhand refrigerator for the apartment.
senses.example_zh: 三位室友把各自的積蓄集中起來，為公寓買了一台二手冰箱。

senses.en: a shared supply of people or things available for use
senses.pattern: a pool of talent / a pool of volunteers / a pool of applicants / a gene pool
senses.example: The company hires its managers from a large [[pool]] of experienced engineers.
senses.example_zh: 這家公司從一個龐大的資深工程師人才庫中聘用經理。

gsat.sentence: The names were chosen from a name [[pool]] composed of 140 names, 10 each from the 14 members of the committee.

senses.en: fairly; to quite a large degree
senses.pattern: pretty good / pretty sure / pretty hard / pretty much
senses.example: The math test was [[pretty]] hard, but most of us managed to finish it in time.
senses.example_zh: 這次數學考試相當難，但我們大多數人都及時寫完了。
senses.note: 口語用法，修飾形容詞或副詞

gsat.sentence: When he returned, he felt “[[pretty]] good.”
This bark can be [[pretty]] thick, well over two feet in the more mature trees.

senses.en: to put pressure on someone to do something
senses.pattern: push sb to do / push sb into / push oneself too hard
senses.example: My parents never [[pushed]] me to become a doctor; they let me choose my own path.
senses.example_zh: 我爸媽從不逼迫我當醫生，他們讓我自己選擇要走的路。

senses.en: a determined effort, or encouragement to do something
senses.pattern: a push for reform / a push to do / give sb a push
senses.example: The city has launched a major [[push]] to reduce plastic waste in night markets.
senses.example_zh: 市政府已展開行動，大力推動夜市減少塑膠垃圾。

gsat.sentence: In everyday situations, too, stress can provide that extra [[push]] needed to do something difficult.

senses.en: considered in comparison with something else
senses.pattern: relative to / the relative merits of / in relative comfort / relative safety
senses.example: While the storm raged outside, the hikers waited in the [[relative]] safety of a small mountain cabin.
senses.example_zh: 外頭風雨交加時，登山客待在相對安全的小山屋裡等候。

senses.en: an official list of names
senses.pattern: call the roll / the class roll / the honor roll
senses.example: The teacher checked the class [[roll]] and found that three students were missing from the bus.
senses.example_zh: 老師核對班級名冊，發現有三名學生沒上車。

senses.en: a small round loaf of bread for one person
senses.pattern: a bread roll / a dinner roll / a roll with butter
senses.example: For breakfast, the hotel served warm [[rolls]] with butter and homemade strawberry jam.
senses.example_zh: 飯店早餐供應溫熱的小圓麵包，搭配奶油和自製草莓果醬。

senses.en: to persuade someone to accept an idea or plan
senses.pattern: sell an idea to sb / sell sb on sth / sell oneself
senses.example: The student council is trying to [[sell]] the idea of a later start time to the principal.
senses.example_zh: 學生會正試著向校長推銷延後上學時間的想法。
senses.note: be sold on sth 完全接受某想法

senses.en: to send goods by any means of transport
senses.pattern: ship an order / ship goods overseas / ship by air
senses.example: Orders placed before noon are usually [[shipped]] by truck on the same day.
senses.example_zh: 中午前下的訂單，通常當天就會以卡車出貨運送。
senses.note: 不限船運，陸運、空運皆可用

senses.en: to be in a particular place or position
senses.pattern: sit on a hill / sit at the foot of sth / sit in the heart of sth
senses.example: The old temple [[sits]] on a hill overlooking the harbor and the fishing boats below.
senses.example_zh: 這座古廟坐落在山丘上，俯瞰著港口和下方的漁船。

senses.en: to be a member of a committee or board
senses.pattern: sit on a committee / sit on a board / sit on a jury
senses.example: Two students were chosen to [[sit]] on the committee that plans the school anniversary celebration.
senses.example_zh: 兩名學生獲選擔任校慶籌備委員會的成員。

gsat.sentence: In 1499, he arrived at Zanzibar, an archipelago [[sitting]] at the crossroads of the Spice Route.

senses.en: not busy; with little business activity
senses.pattern: business is slow / a slow season / a slow day / a slow month
senses.example: Business is always [[slow]] in February, so the shop owner takes her vacation then.
senses.example_zh: 二月的生意總是很清淡，所以店主都在那時休假。

senses.en: taking a long time to act or respond
senses.pattern: be slow to respond / be slow to react / be slow in doing
senses.example: The company was [[slow]] to respond to complaints, and many customers switched to other brands.
senses.example_zh: 該公司遲遲不回應客訴，許多顧客因而改用其他品牌。

gsat.sentence: The French were also [[slow]] to accept forks, for using them was thought to be awkward.

senses.en: to move or stretch in long, twisting curves
senses.pattern: snake through / snake along / snake around / snake its way
senses.example: A narrow mountain road [[snakes]] through the tea fields before reaching the village at the top.
senses.example_zh: 一條狹窄的山路蜿蜒穿過茶園，最後通到山頂的村莊。

senses.en: approximately, used before a number
senses.pattern: some 200 people / some fifty years ago / some thirty miles away
senses.example: [[Some]] three hundred runners finished the mountain race despite the heavy rain and strong wind.
senses.example_zh: 儘管風大雨大，仍有大約三百名跑者完成了這場山徑賽。

senses.en: used for an unknown or unnamed person or thing
senses.pattern: for some reason / some day / some kind of / in some way
senses.example: For [[some]] reason, the printer stopped working just before I had to hand in my report.
senses.example_zh: 基於某個原因，印表機偏偏在我要交報告前壞掉了。

gsat.sentence: For those who speak into the wind phone, hope is always there: They believe that their messages will—through [[some]] unknown way—reach the deceased.

senses.en: to send someone to a place to work or keep guard
senses.pattern: be stationed in Europe / be stationed at the gate / station guards / station troops
senses.example: Volunteers were [[stationed]] at every exit to guide visitors out of the stadium.
senses.example_zh: 每個出口都派駐了志工，引導觀眾離開體育場。
senses.note: 常用被動 be stationed in／at

gsat.sentence: A police officer was [[stationed]] by the side to operate the system.
After the Second World War, a great number of American soldiers were [[stationed]] in Europe.

senses.en: the pointed or thin end of something
senses.pattern: the tip of the tongue / the southern tip of the island / the tip of the iceberg
senses.example: The lighthouse stands on the northern [[tip]] of the island, where the two seas meet.
senses.example_zh: 燈塔矗立在島嶼的最北端，也就是兩片海域交會之處。

senses.en: to lean or fall to one side
senses.pattern: tip over / tip the chair back / tip the balance / tip the scales
senses.example: The canoe [[tipped]] over when both boys leaned to the same side to look at a turtle.
senses.example_zh: 兩個男孩同時往同一側探身去看烏龜，獨木舟就翻倒了。

gsat.sentence: In 1498, Portuguese explorer Vasco da Gama made the first sea voyage to India, via the southernmost [[tip]] of Africa.
According to the analysis, the distance between India’s southern and northern [[tips]] shrinks by 2 cm every year.

senses.en: to be higher than; to be first in
senses.pattern: top the list / top the charts / top one million / top the rankings
senses.example: Ticket sales for the school musical [[topped]] two thousand, breaking last year's record.
senses.example_zh: 學校音樂劇的售票數超過兩千張，打破去年的紀錄。

senses.en: to put something on the top of something
senses.pattern: be topped with cheese / top the cake with fruit / be topped by a tower
senses.example: The shaved ice was [[topped]] with fresh mango and a spoonful of condensed milk.
senses.example_zh: 那碗剉冰上面加了新鮮芒果和一匙煉乳。

senses.en: a piece of clothing for the upper body
senses.pattern: a sleeveless top / a matching top / a pajama top
senses.example: She wore a bright yellow [[top]] with jeans to the class reunion last weekend.
senses.example_zh: 她上週末穿著亮黃色上衣搭配牛仔褲去參加同學會。

gsat.sentence: Cats, dogs, and other pets [[top]] the list, followed by zoo animals.
On the front apron, there is often a kilt pin, [[topped]] with a small decorative family symbol.

senses.en: a series of connected thoughts or events
senses.pattern: a train of thought / a train of events / lose one's train of thought
senses.example: The power failure set off a [[train]] of events that ended with the whole factory closing for a week.
senses.example_zh: 這次停電引發了一連串的事件，最後導致整座工廠停工一週。

senses.en: to aim a camera, gun, or light at something
senses.pattern: train a camera on / train a telescope on / train a light on
senses.example: The photographers [[trained]] their cameras on the door, waiting for the singer to come out.
senses.example_zh: 攝影師們把相機對準門口，等著那位歌手走出來。
senses.note: 常用 train A on B：把 A 對準 B

senses.en: to make someone feel worried or upset
senses.pattern: be troubled by / what troubles me is / a troubled look
senses.example: What [[troubles]] the coach most is that several players have stopped believing in themselves.
senses.example_zh: 最使教練煩惱的是，有幾名球員已不再相信自己。

senses.en: a problem with the body or a machine
senses.pattern: heart trouble / back trouble / stomach trouble / engine trouble
senses.example: My grandfather has had heart [[trouble]] for years and sees his doctor every month.
senses.example_zh: 我爺爺多年來一直有心臟方面的毛病，每個月都要看醫生。

gsat.sentence: Amir was very much [[troubled]] by the donkey’s trick, but did not know what to do.
The country has been [[troubled]] by a problem with trains colliding with deer on its railways.

quiz.stem: By ______ their knowledge and equipment, the two research teams were able to finish the vaccine study in half the expected time.
quiz.explain_zh: pool＝集中（資源、資金）。兩個團隊集中知識與設備，研究提早完成。

quiz.stem: The clever coach ______ a surprising victory by quietly changing the team's game plan during the break.
quiz.explain_zh: engineer＝策劃。教練在休息時悄悄改變戰術，策劃出一場意外的勝利。

quiz.stem: Kevin claimed that his dog had eaten his report, but the teacher didn't ______ his story and asked him to hand it in the next day.
quiz.explain_zh: buy＝相信（說法）。老師不相信凱文「狗吃了報告」的說詞。

quiz.stem: Every bottle of this olive oil ______ a label showing where and when the olives were harvested.
quiz.explain_zh: bear＝帶有。每瓶橄欖油都帶有標示橄欖採收地點與時間的標籤。

quiz.stem: Even after food prices rose sharply, the restaurant ______ its agreement with the school and kept supplying lunches at the original price.
quiz.explain_zh: honor＝履行（協議）。食材漲價後，餐廳仍守約照原價供應學校午餐。

quiz.stem: Researchers warn that findings from studies of adult learners do not always ______ true for young children, whose brains are still developing.
quiz.explain_zh: hold＝適用、成立。針對成人學習者的研究結果，未必適用於大腦仍在發育的幼童。

quiz.stem: By the time the museum opened, a long line of visitors was already ______ around the corner and down the street.
quiz.explain_zh: snake＝蜿蜒伸展。博物館開門時，排隊人龍已蜿蜒繞過轉角、延伸到街上。

quiz.stem: The online store offers a brand-new tablet for only one dollar, but the ______ is that buyers must pay for two years of expensive monthly service.
quiz.explain_zh: catch＝隱藏的問題、圈套。一元平板的代價是得綁兩年昂貴的月租。

quiz.stem: The school fair brought in sixty thousand dollars, but after all the expenses were paid, the ______ profit was only half that amount.
quiz.explain_zh: net＝淨的。園遊會收入六萬元，扣除所有開銷後的淨利只剩一半。

quiz.stem: Thanks to her fluent English and impressive internship experience, Amy ______ a position at an international airline right after graduation.
quiz.explain_zh: land＝得到（工作）。Amy 一畢業就在國際航空公司得到職位。
